Description

Device Improvements for 2025:

  • 2x Device Replacement Warranty - now includes 2 year warranty as standard.
  • Our best battery yet - an advanced 2000mAh Lithium Nickel (NMC/NCA) battery that now lasts 550 cycles, up from 150 cycles in the original Lumo.
  • Rapid Charging - Now charges in under 3 hours, 2 hours less than the original Lumo.
  • Improved LCD - Improved LCD screen that fixes dimming issues and also comes with a 2-year standard (included) replacement warranty.
  • Simplified Menus - Improvements to menus now use simplified language for more easy of use for everyday consumers.

The 5th Generation Lumo, now knows as the Lumo+ is a powerful 5-in-1 anti-aging device that combines advanced technologies to stimulate collagen, tighten facial muscles, and reduce fine lines and wrinkles. Featuring Radio frequency, EMS, and LED light therapy, the Lumo has 5x the micro-current strength and 3x the power of any at-home radio frequency device. 

Its two-tier dermal heating system superheats the dermal layer, promoting collagen and elastin fibroblast growth for a more youthful and radiant complexion.

How it works

• Lumo’s unique two-tier dermal heating system is only available in commercial machines. The higher tier of heating is only triggered for a few seconds (less than 20 seconds) on cooler skin and where the dermal temperature is detected as being higher, the feature automatically defaults to the lower heating of 42 degrees Celsius.

• The Lumo’s RF core has a proprietary targeting system that delivers 95% heat into the dermal layer and features an active semiconductor-based cooling system that removes excess heat from the skin.

• The Lumo is built with titanium electrodes, medical-grade stainless steel, and twice the number of sensors of most competing devices.

• EMS mode operates at 100 Hz/s and packs an average power of 3mA, making it more powerful than typical microcurrent-only devices. Its EMS mode used once a week can provide ongoing benefits for at least 72 to 96 hours post-use.

Included Treatment

Discover the transformative treatments and cutting-edge features that come included with our products.

Visible Skin Lifting & Collagen Boost with Lumo

The Evenskyn Lumo uses advanced radio frequency energy to gently heat the deeper layers of the skin, stimulating natural collagen production and helping restore a firmer, smoother appearance.

  • Radio Frequency (RF) energy penetrates up to 3mm into the skin, delivering controlled warmth to the dermal layer where collagen is produced.
  • Thermal energy up to 60°C (140°F) activates fibroblast cells, stimulating collagen and elastin production for healthier, stronger skin.
  • Existing collagen fibres contract instantly, creating a visible skin tightening and lifting effect.

See smoother, tighter and more lifted-looking skin with consistent use.

Brighter, Smoother & Youthful Skin with Red Light Therapy

The Evenskyn Lumo uses advanced red light photorejuvenation to stimulate cellular activity, improve skin texture, and restore a radiant, youthful complexion.

  • 623nm red light wavelength penetrates the skin to stimulate cellular regeneration.
  • Light energy is absorbed by the mitochondria (the cell’s energy source), boosting cell energy and repair processes.
  • Enhances blood circulation, delivering more oxygen and nutrients to skin cells.
  • Stimulates fibroblasts, increasing collagen and elastin production.

Experience brighter, smoother, and revitalized skin with regular treatments that support your skin’s natural renewal process.
